headline: China October Factory Activity Contracts at Fastest Pace in Three Months
summary: China's factory activity contracted at the fastest pace in three months during October, according to official PMI survey data.
why: China's manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) is a key economic indicator for the world's second-largest economy, providing vital signals on global industrial demand and supply chain health for investors.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Factory activity contracting indicates a slowdown in China's manufacturing sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A faster-than-expected contraction in factory activity signals weaker economic momentum in China, which can weigh on equities, industrial commodities, and regional currencies.
